summary: Hefei Hengxin Life Science and Technology Co., Ltd. is an international enterprise specializing in the research, manufacturing, and distribution of polylactic acid (PLA) products. Its operations span various global markets, including China, North America, Europe, and Australia. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of items such as paper and transparent cups, cup lids, biodegradable cutlery (knives, forks, spoons), drinking straws, stirring rods, foamed foodservice items, food packaging containers, carrier bags, cup holders, and protective cup sleeves. Established in 1997, the firm maintains its headquarters in Hefei, China.
